verses.text: Ha t'a yukil uj ix b'at winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías yet' lajunhwanh soldado t'a Mizpa yik b'at lolon heb' winh yet' winhaj Gedalías chi', junnhej ix wa heb' winh yet' winh. (Ha winhaj Ismael chi', yixchikin pax winh winhaj Elisama, yinhtilal heb' winh rey, niwan yopisio winh t'a winh sreyal Judá t'a yalanhtaxo.)

Yakb'an wan swa heb' winh, ix k'e wa'an winhaj Ismael yet' heb' winh lajunhwanh ajun yet' chi', ix smilancham winhaj Gedalías chi' heb' winh t'a k'e'en espada, haton winh ix ak'jioch gobernadoral t'a Judá yuj winh sreyal Babilonia.
Ix smilanpaxcham masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' soldado aj Babilonia ayek' yet' winhaj Gedalías winhaj Ismael chi'.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Gedalías chi', manta mach tz'ojtakanel tas ix uji chi',

ix k'och 80 heb' winh winak spetoj t'a Siquem, t'a Silo yet' t'a Samaria. Toxo ix sjoxel xil sti' heb' winh, tzilchimtak spichul heb' winh ayochi, haxo sniwanil heb' winh echentak yaji, munil a heb' winh icha chi' ix yutej sb'a. Yet'nak ixim trigo heb' winh yet' incienso yik syak' heb' winh silab'il t'a Jehová t'a templo.

Ha t'a Mizpa chi' ix elta winhaj Ismael chi' ul scha heb' winh, wan stz'akan ok' sb'a winh, haxo yik ix schalan sb'a winh yet' heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Kotanhek, ul ilek winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam, xchi winh.

Palta anhej yik ix k'och heb' winh winak chi' t'a snanhal chonhab' chi', ix miljicham heb' winh yuj winhaj Ismael chi' yet' heb' ajun yet' winh. Ix yumjikanb'at sniwanil heb' winh t'a yol jun niwan jul yet'tal ha'.

Palta ay lajunhwanh heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh wan smiljicham chi' ix halan t'a winhaj Ismael chi': --Manh onh a milchamok, a onh tik ay ixim ko trigo, ixim cebada, ko aceite, ay pax nok' ko yal chab'. Ha juntzanh chi' k'ub'anel kuj t'a spatiktakel ko chonhab', xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' majxo miljokcham heb' winh yuj winhaj Ismael yet' heb' ajun yet' winh.

(Ha jun jul b'aj ix ak'jiem sniwanil heb' winh ix smilcham winhaj Ismael chi', haton jun scheknak winhaj rey Asa joychajok, yik skolannak sb'a winh t'a winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel. Ha jun jul chi' te lewan, palta ix b'ut'ji yuj sniwanil heb' anima ix smilcham winhaj Ismael chi'.)

Ix yik'anb'at heb' ix yisil winh rey winhaj Ismael chi' yet' heb' anima ayek' t'a Mizpa chi', haton heb' ix ak'ji stanhwej winhaj Gedalías yuj winhaj Nabuzaradán. Ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh, yik sb'atkan heb' t'a yol smakb'en Amón presoal.
Haxo yik ix yab'an winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea yet' heb' yajalil soldado ayek' yet'ok, yuj jantak chukal ix sk'ulej winhaj Ismael chi',
ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado heb' winh, ix b'at heb' winh yak' owal yet' winhaj Ismael chi'. Ha b'aj ay jun niwan yet'tal ha' t'a Gabaón, hata' ix ilchaj winh yuj heb' winh.
Haxo heb' wan yik'jib'at icha presoal yuj winhaj Ismael chi', ayik ix yilan winhaj Johanán chi' heb' yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado ajun yet' winh, ix te tzalaj heb'.
Ix meltzaj heb' smasanil, ix yak'anoch sb'a heb' yet' winhaj Johanán chi'.
Palta haxo winhaj Ismael chi' yet' wajxakwanhxo heb' winh ajun yet'ok, ix el lemnaj heb' winh, ix b'atkan heb' winh t'a yol yik Amón.

Ha winhaj Johanán yet' heb' soldado chi' ix ik'anxikanek' heb' anima, ix koljipax heb' yuj heb' winh, haton heb' kajan t'a Mizpa ix yik'b'at winhaj Ismael chi' ayik ix lajwi smilancham winhaj Gedalías winh. Ha juntzanh heb' anima chi', ay heb' winh soldado, ay heb' ix ix, ay heb' unin, ay pax heb' niwak yopisio. Haton heb' ix ik'jixikanek' t'a winhaj Ismael t'a Gabaón

yik sb'at heb' elelal t'a Egipto yujto xiwnak heb' t'a heb' aj Babilonia, yujto ix miljicham winhaj Gedalías, winh ix sik'jioch gobernadoral yuj winh sreyal Babilonia yuj winhaj Ismael. Ix b'atnhej heb', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a Gerut-kimam, t'a slak'anil Belén. Hata' ix och wa'an heb', yujto wan sb'at heb' t'a Egipto chi' yalani.
